questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। z=(λobs−λrest)/λrest=10×(5)/500=(5)/50। denominator rest wavelength, observed নয়।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: এক star parallax 1/3 arcsecond। distance কত parsec?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। Parsec definition d(pc)=1/p(arcsec)। p=1/(3)⇒d=(3) pc; arcsecond degree নয়।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Two circular planets same orbital radius but central star mass M ও 10M। period ratio second/first কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। Newton–Kepler T=2π√(r³/(GM))। same r-এ T∝M⁻½, তাই ratio 1/√(10)।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: H₀=70km/s/Mpc, galaxy distance 5Mpc; local linear approximation। recession speed কত km/s?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। Hubble law v≈H₀d for low redshift; multiply 70×(5) with Mpc cancel to km/s।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Star A apparent magnitude 10, B magnitude 15। flux FA/FB কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। Pogson relation magnitude difference 5 corresponds flux ratio 100। Smaller magnitude brighter⇒A has100×B flux।
